# falcon.recognition.v1

*Engine · recognition · package `linecaster-services`*

linecaster engine for the recognition step: a whole page through Falcon-OCR's pipeline service (layout, a
request per crop, the vendor's Markdown assembly), behind its HTTP API. The service runs in the vendor's image
(`ServiceServer` starts it); the engine is its client, in the pipeline's process.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Class | `linecaster_services:FalconRecognitionEngine` |
| Source | [falcon.py](https://github.com/storytracer/linecaster/blob/main/engines/services/src/linecaster_services/falcon.py) |
| Reads | pages |
| Produces | lines, text, markdown |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint` | `str` | `'http://127.0.0.1:5002'` | the pipeline service's base URL (the vendor image's port 5002, on loopback) |
| `longest_edge` | `int` | `2048` | the page is scaled down (LANCZOS, never up) so its longest side is at most this many pixels before it is sent |
| `jpeg_quality` | `int` | `95` | the JPEG quality the page is sent at |
| `skip_layout` | `bool` | `False` | the vendor's direct VLM path without layout detection; false: the full-page pipeline (layout, crops, assembly) |
| `timeout` | `float` | `1800.0` | seconds a page's request may take |
